items.title: BOLI ZAINAB UTHO IMDAD KO AAO ABBAS
items.body:
BOLI ZAINAB UTHO IMDAD KO AAO ABBAS
ZIBHA HOTA HAE MERA BHAYI ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR TOH SHAH KA AB SAJDAE QALIQ MEIN JHUKA
HAATH SE SHUMR KE QANJAR KO CHUDAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
AB SAKINA PAH YATEEMI KA SITAM TOOT GAYA
AB TARAS KHAO KALEJE SE LAGAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
AAG QAIMON MEIN LAGANE CHALE AAE HAIN ADOO
GHASH MEIN HAE ABEDE BEEMAR JAGAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
JO RIDAH HAZRATE ZEHRA KI THI MERE SAR PAR
WOH RIDAH SHUMR NE CHEENE HAE DILAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
LAASHE BESAR SE HAE LIPTI HUI NANHI BACHHI
AAO NADAAN SAKINA KO CHUDAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
MERE BAAZU MEIN RASAN BAANDHTA HAE SHUMRE SHAQI
IS AZEEYAT SE BEHAN KO TOH BACHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SAATH GHURBAT MEIN YATEEMON KO NA CHODO BHAIYA
MAIN BULAATI HOON MERE PAAS TOH AAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
HONE TASHEER CHALI JAATI HAE NASHAAD BEHAN
FOUJE AADA KO JALAL APNA DIKHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
TUMSE KARTI HOON SIFAARISH YEHI HYDER KE LIYE
APNE QADMON MEIN JAGAH USKO DILAO ABBAS

items.title: AYE SALAAMI KHIYAAM JALTEY HAIN
items.body:
AYE SALAAMI KHIYAAM JALTEY HAIN
RUN MAY NAAMOOS-E-SHEH NIKALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
RUN MAY BAJTHAY HAIN FATHA KAY BAAJEY
DARR SEY BEYVOUN KE DUM NIKALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAITHI HAIN BIBIYAN ANDHERAY MEIN
SHAAMIYON MAY CHARAAG JALTHAY HAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
ZERAY KHANJAR HAIN GARDANAY SHABBIR
MURTUZA GHAM SE HAATH MALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
QABR-E-ASGHAR SAY KAHTI THI BANU
AYE LAHAD HUM YAHAAN SAY CHALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
TU HAMAARI TARHA SE BEHLAANA
SHAB KO ASGHAR BAHOT MACHALTAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
PEISH HAAKIM KHADEY HAIN AHLE HARAM
SAB KAY CHEHROUN PA ASHK DHALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAINCHTAY HAIN GALEY SEY TEER HUSSAIN
MU SEY ASGHAR LAHU UGALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAKHM JALTHAY HAIN GARM HAI JO ZAMEEN
SHAAHEY DEEN KARWATAIN BADALTHAY HAIN
